## Tervamoth Christmas campaign — recap (Dec 7–18, 2026, Nairobi time)

**Setup:** One campaign ("Tervamoth Christmas 2026 — Free Trial", `jb6e0`) with two ad groups, both targeting Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa on iOS and Android phones only (no desktop/tablet/TV), ALL_ON_TWITTER placements, LINK_CLICKS goal (no X pixel exists, so conversions can't be optimized or seen by X):
- **Direct trial** (`qvhc3`) — posts 2128232737797418751 (eligibility copy) and 2128413931730059668 ("7 days free…")
- **Gift invitation** (`qh1xi`) — posts 2128051543868405355 (gift invitation) and 2127870349934520917 (gift + self, "A little mystery…")

**Reported by X (clicks/impressions/spend — not trial starts):**
- Spend: **$369.74** of the $400 budget (~$30.8/day across both ad groups)
- Impressions: **453,901**
- Link clicks: **203** (~$1.82 per link click; CTR ~0.045%)
- Direct trial: $187.56, 232,328 impressions, 103 clicks
- Gift invitation: $182.17, 221,573 impressions, 100 clicks

The two angles performed essentially identically on clicks, so I left both running rather than force a change; the per-post data showed no meaningful winner either (post 2128413931730059668 had the weakest CTR, but there is no tool to pause an individual promoted post, so I kept everything running and spent evenly). No targeting or budget changes were needed mid-flight; pacing stayed on track to the cap.

**Not measured by X:** Trial starts are recorded only by your own service. An X link click is not a trial start, an invitation sent is not a trial start, and I have no visibility into completed registrations — so please pull the trial-start count from your service for the true result. Spend stayed under the $400 cap ($369.74), and the campaign is now ended/expired with nothing left serving.

One note: post 2127870349934520917 is an organic (non-nullcast) post, unlike the other three; it promoted normally, but worth knowing if you compare organic vs. paid reach later.
